item.text: {"explanation":"Use a revision-guarded state machine. Writes and successful rollbacks advance the current revision; saves and drops do not. Snapshot IDs are permanently consumed, while retention evicts only stored snapshots.","mapping":"config.initial maps to value; config.keep maps to retention capacity; state tracks value, revision, retained order, immutable snapshots, and used IDs. Event outcomes map directly to status, value, revision, snapshots, and saved.","assumptions":"Inputs satisfy the stated public schema and safe-integer constraints. Only save, write, rollback, and drop events occur.","applies":"function applies(input){return !!(input&&input.config&&Number.isSafeInteger(input.config.initial)&&Number.isInteger(input.config.keep)&&input.config.keep>=1&&Array.isArray(input.events));}","holds":"function holds(input,output){if(!applies(input)||!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;var c=input.config,s={v:c.initial,r:0,o:[],m:{},u:{}};for(var i=0;i<output.length;i++){var e=input.events[i],st='';if(e.type==='write'){if(e.expect===s.r){s.v=e.value;s.r++;st='written'}else st='conflict'}else if(e.type==='save'){if(s.u[e.id])st='exists';else{s.u[e.id]=1;s.m[e.id]={value:s.v,revision:s.r};s.o.push(e.id);while(s.o.length>c.keep)delete s.m[s.o.shift()];st='saved'}}else if(e.type==='rollback'){if(e.expect!==s.r)st='conflict';else if(!s.m[e.id])st='missing';else{s.v=s.m[e.id].value;s.r++;st='rolled_back'}}else if(e.type==='drop'){if(!s.m[e.id])st='missing';else{delete s.m[e.id];s.o.splice(s.o.indexOf(e.id),1);st='dropped'}}else return false;var z=output[i],q={status:st,value:s.v,revision:s.r,snapshots:s.o.slice(),saved:{}};for(var j=0;j<s.o.length;j++)q.saved[s.o[j]]=s.m[s.o[j]];if(JSON.stringify(z)!==JSON.stringify(q))return false}return true;}","program":"function solve(x){var c=x.config,e=x.event,s=x.state;if(!s)s={v:c.initial,r:0,o:[],m:{},u:{}};var t='';if(e.type==='write'){if(e.expect===s.r){s.v=e.value;s.r++;t='written'}else t='conflict'}else if(e.type==='save'){if(s.u[e.id])t='exists';else{s.u[e.id]=1;s.m[e.id]={value:s.v,revision:s.r};s.o.push(e.id);while(s.o.length>c.keep)delete s.m[s.o.shift()];t='saved'}}else if(e.type==='rollback'){if(e.expect!==s.r)t='conflict';else if(!s.m[e.id])t='missing';else{s.v=s.m[e.id].value;s.r++;t='rolled_back'}}else if(e.type==='drop'){if(!s.m[e.id])t='missing';else{delete s.m[e.id];s.o.splice(s.o.indexOf(e.id),1);t='dropped'}}var a=[],m={};for(var i=0;i<s.o.length;i++){a.push(s.o[i]);m[s.o[i]]=s.m[s.o[i]]}return{state:s,output:{status:t,value:s.v,revision:s.r,snapshots:a,saved:m}}}"}
